result: no execution blocker found in reviewed development protocol

openingSelection.rule: Lowest sixteen SHA256(salt + NUL + sourceGameId), in hash order.

codeReviewFindings: Every game search receives the registered time budget with no fixed-node ceiling; node-bounded warmup is separate.
The schedule retains both candidate colors on the same opening at every time control and rotates budget/color order prospectively.
The bootstrap resamples complete coarse families and uses the same family draw across all time controls; its variable denominator correctly retains the declared opening-weighted estimand.
The four-budget Bonferroni percentile calculation uses 0.00625 and 0.99375 quantiles for the nominal simultaneous 95 percent bands.
Degenerate empirical bootstrap distributions receive [0,1], avoiding a zero-width certainty claim.

Runner and closed-ledger auditor reconstruct the complete legal opening and continuation histories. Every search request is reconstructed from that history, and final JavaScript replay plus PGN moves/results are checked.
Checkmate and natural rule draws are checked before the searched-ply cap; there is no score adjudication or resignation.
Audit requires the complete scheduled ledger, all games and PGNs, source identities, and completion seals before outcome analysis.
The analyzer does not enable production, interpolate a crossing threshold, or treat fixed-node cost as playing-strength admission.

timingInterpretation.registeredCleanCheck: Time-limit-stop median candidate/base ratio within [0.9,1.1] and each time-limit-stop p99 at most twice the requested budget.
timingInterpretation.productionDeadlineImplementation: Captured r85 arms now_ms() + time_ms and checks the deadline at 1024-node intervals.
limitations: The clean flag is not a hard per-request deadline guarantee.
Its predicate does not separately enforce an absolute lower duration, all-stop tail limits, or full-request latency equality.
After completion, inspect under-budget time-limit stops and report full-request distributions without changing the registered admission rule based on outcomes.

statisticalInterpretation: Ten coarse clusters, including a cluster containing five of sixteen pairs, provide a small exploratory sample.
The nominal Bonferroni bootstrap bands are approximate descriptive intervals, not a verified coverage guarantee.
The source bank is already exposed development data; any candidate region needs a fresh separately registered confirmation campaign.
scope: Read-only source and prospective registration/input review completed before observing any game outcomes.
The opening hash selection and cluster mapping were independently recomputed from the retained opening source.
No game engine, tests, timing experiment, or complete raw-game audit was executed for this review.
This protocol review does not certify the future game ledger; independent replay of the completely sealed campaign remains required.
